data_section_full_text:
Sample and Descriptive Statistics

We collected fee data for 4,959 firms from U.S. registrants’ 2000 proxy statements that
were available on EDGAR or Global Access during November and December 2001. We
deleted 761 financial firms and 1,028 firms that lacked the necessary financial data on
Compustat to estimate our fee models arriving at a final sample of 3,170 firms.
